einzeiler: Christian Long and his 80-year-old mother Wendy launch their new podcast, Oh Honey!
kurzfassung: Christian Long and his mother Wendy introduce their new weekly podcast, discussing aging, family memories, and listener questions. They share personal stories about coffee discounts, childhood discipline, and reflections on Christian's previous podcast. The duo invites listeners to submit questions and advice requests for future episodes.
stichpunkte: Christian Long and his mother Wendy premiere their weekly podcast titled Oh Honey!
The hosts discuss perceptions of age, voice tones, and terminology within the gay community such as twinks and bears.
Wendy shares her experiences getting senior discounts at a local drive-thru and dealing with severe back arthritis at age 80.
The pair reflects on childhood memories, including school discipline in the eighth grade and being teased for lack of leg hair.
Christian discusses purchasing the domain name ohhoney.com and setting up a dedicated email address for listener correspondence.
They read their inaugural listener letter from a fan named Maverick, addressing questions about family, fame, and why Christian's past podcast ended.
The episode concludes with plans for future weekly discussions, potential guest appearances, and answering more listener submissions.

clips.hook: Too old to be a twink
clips.text: The host reflects on no longer fitting into specific community terminology due to advancing age.
Specific monetary details are discussed regarding the exact price increase and discount for a cup of coffee.
The conversation turns toward a pricey memory-recording service that went completely unused.
A candid revelation is made about the complex circumstances and decision behind the conclusion of a prior podcast.
A surprising suggestion is made regarding alternative substances, leading to an amusing exchange about trying natural remedies.

beschreibung:
Christian Long and his 80 year old mom, Wendy Long introduce the very first (inaugural?) episode of "Oh Honey!" They discuss what listeners have to look forward to, why Wendy was tempted to return her coffee from The Doughnut Inn, and why she's unlikely to ever try 'shrooms. To continue listening to new Oh Honey! episodes every Tuesday subscribe on Apple, Spotify, or Amazon Music.
